factors.label: Supplier-contract linkage
factors.description: Whether a supplier can be linked to a real public contract in Mexican official procurement records (CompraNet/compras publicas).

factors.label: Corporate identity legitimacy
factors.description: Whether the supplier is a legitimate registered company, verified via Mexican public commercial registries (identity, founding date).

factors.label: Tax-list status (SAT lista 69-B)
factors.description: The supplier's status on the Mexican tax authority's lists, including lista 69-B, as a primary Mexican source.

factors.label: Sanction status
factors.description: Whether the supplier appears on sanctions lists, checked via US sanctions lists (OFAC) as secondary cross-checks only.

factors.label: Address verification
factors.description: Completeness and verifiability of the supplier's registered address as one of the five core profile fields.

factors.label: Source authority tier
factors.description: Distinction between primary Mexican official sources and secondary US cross-check sources; Mexican sources are the primary authority.

factors.label: Evidence citation completeness
factors.description: Every recorded value must cite evidence; no unsourced values are permitted, and at least 4 distinct source classes must be used.

factors.label: Core profile completeness
factors.description: Whether a linked supplier has a complete core profile across all five fields (identity, address, founding date, tax-list status, sanction status), targeted at >=80% of linked suppliers.

classes.label: Supplier
classes.description: Company receiving public money through a Mexican government contract; carries the five core profile fields (identity, address, founding date, tax-list status, sanction status) as DoD properties.

classes.label: Public Contract
classes.description: Award record from Mexican official procurement sources (CompraNet / compras publicas) linking an awarding agency, value and date to a supplier RFC.

classes.label: Evidence Record
classes.description: Citation backing a recorded value, tagged with its source class and authority tier (primary Mexican vs secondary US cross-check).

properties.label: Legal name
properties.description: Registered legal name of the company (core profile: identity).

properties.label: RFC
properties.description: Mexican tax identifier (RFC) used to match the supplier on contracts and SAT records.

properties.label: Registered address
properties.description: Registered address of the company (core profile: address).

properties.label: Founding date
properties.description: Date the company was founded / registered (core profile: founding date).

properties.label: SAT 69-B status
properties.description: Status on the SAT lista 69-B tax-authority lists (core profile: tax-list status).

properties.label: Sanction status
properties.description: Result of sanctions screening, e.g. OFAC SDN as a secondary cross-check (core profile: sanction status).

properties.label: Contract ID
properties.description: Official identifier of the procurement award record.

properties.label: Contract title
properties.description: Title or object of the awarded contract.

properties.label: Supplier RFC on contract
properties.description: RFC of the awarded supplier as recorded on the contract.

properties.label: Awarding agency
properties.description: Government dependency or agency that awarded the contract.

properties.label: Contract value
properties.description: Monetary value of the award in MXN.

properties.label: Evidence ID
properties.description: Stable identifier of the evidence citation.

properties.label: Evidence label
properties.description: Human-readable description of the cited evidence.

properties.label: Source class
properties.description: Distinct source class of the evidence (e.g. compranet, sat, registro_publico_comercio, ofac).

properties.label: Authority tier
properties.description: Authority tier of the source: primary_mexican_source, secondary_us_cross_check or review_tier.

properties.label: Source URL
properties.description: Resolvable URL of the cited source.

properties.label: Retrieved at
properties.description: Timestamp when the evidence was retrieved.

rules.label: Mexican official sources are primary authority
rules.checks: r4: US sanctions and registry lists are used only as secondary cross-checks.
verify: Confirm that primary claims rest on Mexican official sources; US lists appear only as secondary cross-checks.

source_classes.label: SAT RFC & lista 69-B (primary MX tax authority)
Registro Público de Comercio (primary MX commercial registry)

revisions.reason: Three defects against the approved PRD. (1) The five core profile fields (identity, registered address, founding date, tax-list status, sanction status) sit on a separate core_profile class, but dod2 measures completeness on the primary class supplier, which then has no DoD properties, so dod2 can never be met. Make them properties of supplier (dod: true) and drop core_profile; keep evidence per value. (2) dod1 counts public_contract entities; the PRD says >=50 SUPPLIERS linked to real public contracts, so count suppliers with at least one awarded contract. (3) Rule r_dod4_source_class_diversity's predicate (authority_tier = primary_mexican_source) does not express its label (>=4 distinct source classes); fix or drop it, since dod4 is already measured by its query. Keep everything else. [Delegated decision by the orchestrator agent under the user's criteria, coord/briefs/approval-delegation.md]

Classes, properties, the relation and the DoD queries are now right; keep them exactly. Only the rules are wrong: r_dod1_contract_linkage, r_dod3_no_unsourced_values and r_dod4_source_class_diversity compare a property with itself (always true), and r_dod2_core_profile_complete tests 'not listed and not sanctioned', which is not completeness. Remove these four rules; the DoD is measured by dod-queries. Keep r_primary_authority. [Delegated decision by the orchestrator agent under the user's criteria, coord/briefs/approval-delegation.md]
